title: ID0447363-DC/Si-D/SE-[RVP/T2 170004469]-Cable clamp and ropebox broken
description:
Reported behavior/issue:
When a technician arrived to replace a broken cable, he discovered that the cable clamp was broken and the rope had slipped in to the ropebox.
Solution:
Replace cable clamp and ropebox.
